# Chestnut Rain · Inline Metal Shader
Thirty-two chestnut pieces fall continuously through a soft autumn sky. Most are green or golden spiky husks, some split to reveal their brown interior; four are glossy bare chestnuts with a pale base. Each piece has its own fall speed, gentle wind drift, and tumble. The source lives in the Text node and needs no external texture or shader file. JSON State advances time by 1/60 second per Loop call; Loop is capped at 60 Hz. Width and Height control full-screen preview and saved output; reduce them if rendering is slow.
